title: IMUI Table Body Owner Split v1
problem: After the private table header owner split, `ecosystem/fret-ui-kit/src/imui/table_controls.rs` still owns body row assembly, pinned column grouping, horizontal scroll wrapping, cell wrapping, and public table authoring. This lane moves the private body/pinning/scroll renderer behind `table_controls/body.rs` while keeping public IMUI table names, response shapes, test-id shapes, and runtime contracts unchanged.

repro.summary: Run focused IMUI table smoke and interaction gates proving hidden columns, horizontal scroll, pinned groups, sortable headers, and resize behavior stay unchanged after the private body owner split.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-kit --features imui --test imui_table_smoke table_sortable_header_api_compiles table_resizable_column_api_compiles --no-fail-fast

gates.name: ui-kit-table-smoke
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-kit --features imui --test imui_table_smoke table_sortable_header_api_compiles table_resizable_column_api_compiles --no-fail-fast

continue_policy.notes: This lane is closed for the private table body/pinning/scroll owner split. Do not reopen it for public table APIs, table engines, sizing persistence, runtime table semantics, or new table behavior; start a new owner-split follow-on only with fresh proof pressure.
